appetite.definitionKo: 음식을 먹을 때 입에서 느끼는 맛. 또는 음식을 먹고 싶은 욕구.
appetite.englishDescription: The taste that one feels when eating, or the desire to eat.
One's inclination of liking or disliking a certain food.
The appetite to eat a meal.

appetite.definitionKo: 무엇을 하고 싶어 하는 마음이나 관심. 또는 그런 일.
appetite.englishDescription: A desire for, or interest in, doing something, or such a thing.

appetite.definitionKo: 어떤 음식을 먹고 싶어 하는 마음.

carrier.definitionKo: 병의 증상은 보이지 않지만 몸 안에 병균을 가지고 있는 사람.
carrier.englishDescription: A person who has a germ for a disease although he/she does not show any symptoms of the disease.
A ship for transporting goods, etc.

carrier.definitionKo: 돈을 받고 사람을 태워 나르거나 물건을 실어 나르는 일을 직업으로 하는 사람.
carrier.englishDescription: A person whose job it is to receive money for carrying people or goods in a vehicle.

cashier.definitionKo: 돈이나 물건을 내주거나 받아들이는 일을 맡아보는 사람.
cashier.englishDescription: A person responsible for receiving and giving money or goods.

cigarette.definitionKo: 얇은 종이로 가늘고 길게 말아서 만든 담배.
cigarette.englishDescription: Cigarettes made by rolling a thin paper thin and long.

cigarette.definitionKo: 담배의 개수나 담배를 피우는 횟수를 세는 단위.
cigarette.englishDescription: A bound noun that serves as a unit for counting the number of cigarettes or the frequency of smoking.

cigarette.definitionKo: 말린 담배의 잎을 가늘게 썰어서 종이에 말고 불을 붙여서 그 연기를 마실 수 있도록 만든 것.
cigarette.englishDescription: A product made by cutting dried tobacco leaves into thin strips, rolling them in paper, lighting them, and inhaling the smoke.

cosmetics.definitionKo: 예쁘게 보이기 위해, 또는 피부를 가꾸기 위해 얼굴에 바르는 물건.
cosmetics.englishDescription: A substance applied over the face to make oneself look more beautiful or to pamper the skin.

demonstration.definitionKo: 남에게 겁을 주거나 인정을 받기 위해 자신의 힘이나 의견을 일부러 보임.
demonstration.englishDescription: The act of showing one's power or expressing one's opinion on purpose in order to threaten another person or be acknowledged by him/her.

demonstration.definitionKo: 많은 사람들이 요구 조건을 내걸고 집회나 행진을 하며 의사를 표시하는 행동.
demonstration.englishDescription: The act of a lot of people expressing their opinions through a rally or march demanding some conditions.

demonstration.definitionKo: 어떤 주장이나 이론의 옳고 그름을 논리적인 이유를 들어 증명함. 또는 그 근거나 이유.
demonstration.englishDescription: The act of proving the right or wrong of an argument or theory through logical reasoning, or such a base or reason.

demonstration.definitionKo: 어떤 의견을 널리 알리기 위해 여러 사람이 한데 모여 구호를 외치거나 집단적으로 행동함.
demonstration.englishDescription: The act of a lot of people shouting a slogan or behaving as a group in order to let the public know their opinion about an issue.
The act of showing how to do something by doing it.

demonstration.definitionKo: 무용이나 연극 등을 일반 관객에게 보여 주기 전에 전문가나 특정한 사람들에게 먼저 보여 주는 것.
demonstration.englishDescription: The act of showing a dance, play, etc., in front of a particular group of people or experts before showing it to the general public.
The act of showing as a model example.
Proving a certain fact by presenting proof.

demonstration.definitionKo: 무용이나 연극 등을 일반 관객에게 보여 주기 전에 특정한 사람들에게 시험 삼아 먼저 보여 줌.
demonstration.englishDescription: The act of showing a dance, play, etc., in front of a particular group of people as a trial before showing it to the general public.

elevation.definitionKo: 자격이나 등급, 지위 등이 높아짐. 또는 그것을 높임.
elevation.englishDescription: A rise in rank, position, or qualifications, or raising them.

elevation.definitionKo: 흙이나 돌 등을 높고 평평하게 쌓아 올린 것.
elevation.englishDescription: Soil, stones, rocks, etc., evenly stacked in height.
The act of increasing a figure, limit, standard, etc.

elevation.definitionKo: 바닷물의 표면으로부터 잰 육지나 산의 높이.
elevation.englishExpression: elevation; altitude; being above sea level
elevation.englishDescription: The height of a piece of land or mountain, measured from the surface of the sea.

elevation.definitionKo: 평균 해수면 등을  0으로 하여 측정한 어떤 물체의 높이.
elevation.englishDescription: The height of an object measured by setting the average sea level, etc., as 0.

enticement.definitionKo: 듣기 좋은 말이나 행동으로 다른 사람을 속이거나 부추겨서 자기가 바라는 대로 하게 하는 일.
enticement.englishDescription: A tempting remark or behavior of someone intended to manipulate or incite others to do something he or she wants.

enticement.definitionKo: 정신을 혼미하게 하거나 잘못된 행동을 하도록 꾐.
enticement.englishDescription: Confusing the mind or tempting someone to do something wrong.

farmhouse.englishDescription: A house where a farmer lives.

luxuriance.englishDescription: A state in which trees and plants grow profusely.

nobility.englishDescription: A distinguished, valuable thing or person.

nobility.definitionKo: 타고난 신분이나 사회적 계급이 높은 계층. 또는 그런 계층에 속한 사람.
nobility.englishDescription: The class of high social status or ranking, or a person that belongs to such a class.
A certain quality or class that one finds respectful in an object, etc.

pastime.definitionKo: 심심함을 달래며 시간을 보내려고 어떤 일을 함. 또는 그런 일.
pastime.englishDescription: An act of doing something to have fun or to kill time, or something done for this purpose.

pastime.definitionKo: 어떤 일에 재미를 붙여서 심심하지 않게 세월을 보냄.
pastime.englishDescription: An activity to pass the time without getting bored.

pastime.definitionKo: 심심하지 않게 세월을 보내기 위해 하는 일.
pastime.englishDescription: An activity to pass the time without getting bored.

reciprocation.englishDescription: An act of doing a certain act in return for another's poem, song, etc.

retry.definitionKo: 판결이 이미 확정된 후에 중요한 잘못이 발견되어서 다시 재판하다.
retry.englishDescription: To hold another trial after a judgement was rendered because a material flaw has been found.

tadpole.definitionKo: 개구리가 되기 전까지 네 다리 없이 꼬리로 헤엄치는 개구리의 새끼.
tadpole.englishDescription: The baby of a frog, which does not have four legs yet, and thus swims by using its tail until it becomes an adult frog.

tadpole.definitionKo: (비유적으로) 초보자 또는 지위나 실력이 제일 낮은 사람.
tadpole.englishDescription: (figurative) A novice or a person who is in the lowest position or has the poorest ability in a group.

tadpole.definitionKo: (놀리는 말로) 배가 몹시 나온 사람. 또는 그 사람의 배.
tadpole.englishDescription: (teasing) A person who has developed a potbelly; the belly of the person.

tensely.definitionKo: 주먹에 힘을 주어 꽉 쥐는 모양.
tensely.englishDescription: In the manner of clenching one's fists.

tensely.definitionKo: 주먹에 힘을 주어 자꾸 꽉 쥐는 모양.
tensely.englishDescription: In the manner of clenching one's fists repeatedly.
A word describing the state of something being very solid and strong.

tensely.definitionKo: 정세나 분위기 등이 부드럽지 못하고 매우 딱딱한 정도로.
tensely.englishDescription: In a situation, atmosphere, etc., which is very stiff, not smooth.

unfortunately.englishDescription: In a way that is not fortunate.
